The other fifteen pins of the same one net. Row spacing is a real 15.24 mm, which is the only correct dimension here.
Parametric stand-in: the 2020 KiCad packages3D freeze has no USB-C model. Body from the HRO datasheet. VBUS lands on a pad that connects to nothing; D+/D- go to two LEDs.
Parametric stand-in, same reason. The real Jumperless probe is a TRRRS jack sensing a 92-resistor divider. This is a plain TRS jack wired to the board edge.
Parametric stand-in for an EC11 encoder body. Both quadrature phases land on the same net, so it can only ever report zero.

Back-mounted CR2032 holder silkscreened as four independently programmable +-8 V supplies. Both pads are symmetric about the footprint origin, so the back-side mirror does not swap them; an asymmetric part here would have needed its nets remapped.
